title: Remove the central audit log copy from the website text
body:
Child of catenahq/ops#474 (umbrella, parent-task). The SPEC.md row (catena-ce) and the features.yml entry (ops) named there are already gone from main; only this repository's part remains.

`src/i18n/en/common.json` (key `collect_body`, around line 352) and its French pair still name the central audit log copy. Reword both to match the legal text of the contracts issue this one is blocked by.

title: A content collection for case studies or a blog
body:
Worth setting up an Astro content collection in `src/` once there are three or more entries to populate (client
write-ups, postmortems, or a public roadmap log). Premature with zero entries.

Moved from catenahq/ops#284.

title: Create a Catena Dashboard demo
body:
- Build it as a static webpage replicating a Catena Admin deployment, with no interactive fields.
- Optionally base it on screenshots from a real deployment, with credentials hidden. Add a few apps and their settings.
- Make its primary zone "catena.run".
- Make it a Business licensed instance.
- Deploy a new version of the page on each Catena release.
- Deploy it on GitHub Pages at demo.catena.run.
- Add a link in the top menu bar of catena.run.

Moved from catenahq/ops#391.

title: Fix the editions section for backups
body:
Automatic backups are available to every edition. Frequency is limited to weekly for Community, and is unlimited for Pro
and Business.

The editions table should reflect that:

| Automatic backups | Weekly | Unlimited | Unlimited |

Text in place of check marks or crosses in the table is fine.

Moved from catenahq/ops#494.

title: The terms page contradicts the agreements and links none of them
body:
The terms page (`src/i18n/*/common.json` `terms`) says "no minimum term" where the MSA's section 3.1 says six months
(being reworded in the contracts issue this one is blocked by), and calls the engagement letter the canonical contract.
No page links to `/{en,fr}/legal/*`.

- **Behaviour:** the terms page describes the same pricing model as the agreements and links them, in English and French.
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** the website build passes; the terms page links each agreement.

Part of catenahq/ops#282 (Docs and spec issues: Legal text describes a pricing model that is not the decided one), which tracks the change across repositories. Blocked by catenahq/contracts#23, the part before it in push order.

title: Hosted jobs run on a stated Ubuntu image
body:
GitHub moves `ubuntu-latest` to Ubuntu 26.04 between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-19. Every hosted job of this repository
moves with the label as the rollout reaches it.

- **Behaviour:** every workflow runs on a stated image: `runs-on: ubuntu-26.04` after one passing run, or
  `ubuntu-24.04` pinned.
- **Security notes:** none.
- **Acceptance:** one CI pass on `runs-on: ubuntu-26.04`, or the pin in place. Workflow changes need a person with the
  Workflows permission.

Part of catenahq/ops#323 (GitHub moves ubuntu-latest to Ubuntu 26.04 between 2026-10-19 and 2026-11-19), which tracks the change across repositories. Blocked by catenahq/docs#105, the part before it in push order.

title: Editions comparison: backups every 15 minutes on Pro
body:
A Pro server scheduled every 15 minutes runs a backup every 15 minutes. Publish it on the edition comparison once the test
bench proves it on a licensed host (the docs issue this one is blocked by states the same).

- **Behaviour:** the edition comparison names the 15-minute cadence, in English and French.
- **Acceptance:** the website build passes.

Part of catenahq/ops#368 (Frequent backups: prove and publish), which tracks the change across repositories. Blocked by catenahq/docs#106, the part before it in push order.
